title: M64/60 charge-air path geometry study (compressor outlet to throttle bodies)
status_limits: Concept geometry only. No part in this folder may be declared dimensionally correct, fitted, tested, safe, released, or manufacturing-ready.
bom_coverage_note: The wave-1 master engine BOM carries no dimensions for the charge-air line: vendor product envelopes exist (FVD, TA Technix, AKS DASIS, Albert Motorsport fiches), so every geometric dimension below is tagged ASSUMPTION or SOURCED_ENVELOPE, never measured.
coordinate_system: mm, right-handed engine frame of twins/m64-engine-system: +X rear along crank axis, +Z up, banks mirrored about Y=0.

evidence_classes.SOURCED_ENVELOPE: third-party product envelope, reference-only copyright, packaging bound not interface dimension
evidence_classes.ASSUMPTION: engineering placeholder, order of magnitude only

dimensions.name: fVoxelSizeMm
dimensions.basis: study resolution, same family as layout scaffold voxel choice; not a manufacturing resolution

dimensions.name: fWallThicknessMm
dimensions.basis: no charge-air wall data in BOM or vendor fiches

dimensions.name: fRadialClearanceMm
dimensions.basis: sealing design undefined

dimensions.name: fHoseMinBendRadiusMm
dimensions.basis: no vendor bend-radius law published

dimensions.name: fNominalDuctOuterDiaMm
dimensions.basis: TA Technix aftermarket intercooler declares 66 mm outer / 68 mm inner connector stubs; not OEM

dimensions.name: fNominalDuctBoreDiaMm
dimensions.basis: fNominalDuctOuterDiaMm - 2*fWallThicknessMm

dimensions.name: fCouplingLengthMm
dimensions.basis: no published coupling geometry

dimensions.name: fCouplingOverDiaMm
dimensions.basis: +6 mm radial sleeve placeholder

dimensions.name: aTubeWaypointsPosBank
dimensions.basis: routing hypothesis inside the layout-scaffold envelope; no OEM charge-air drawing exists in the repository
dimensions.anchor_source: SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TURBO-PET (locates the circuit, publishes no coordinates)

dimensions.name: vecIntercoolerCentre
dimensions.basis: PET illustration 107-45 locates the charge-air cooler ahead of the engine; no coordinates published

dimensions.name: fIntercoolerCore{Len,Width,Depth}Mm
dimensions.basis: AKS DASIS OE-matched core 260x270x60; Albert Motorsport and TA Technix declare 260x260x100 cores; envelopes only

dimensions.name: fPlenum* (length/width/height/centre/corner)
dimensions.basis: plenum form invented; the three-runner intake kit designation (46x42x100, no interface geometry) gives no plenum dimensions

dimensions.name: fThrottleBoreDiaMm
dimensions.basis: no throttle dimension in any local source

dimensions.name: aRunnerOffsetsY
dimensions.basis: spacing = stroke 76.4 mm (FACT_public) + 10 mm gap (ASSUMPTION), matching the layout scaffold

dimensions.name: aHoseWaypointsPosBank
dimensions.basis: centerline routing hypothesis; FVD hoses publish product envelopes only

dimensions.name: fHoseOuterRadiusMm
dimensions.basis: half of the FVD reinforced-kit declared 57 mm upper diameter; envelope bound, not a section spec

dimensions.name: fHoseWallMm
dimensions.basis: section law not published

dimensions.name: fHoseEnvelope{Min,Max}LenMm
dimensions.basis: FVD kit 410 mm connection length; left/right replacement hoses 430 mm product length; used only for a centerline-length sanity report

dimensions.name: fBoostTargetBar
dimensions.basis: study brief target for the 3.6 L twin-turbo; a load input, not a dimension

dimensions.name: fBoostOemBar
dimensions.basis: Christophorus / Porsche newsroom: 993 Turbo max boost 0.8 bar

build_state.reason: host dotnet SDK 6.0.400 cannot target net9.0 (NETSDK1045); build must run in the pinned picogk-m64 image
